title: Document all 9 shipped custom_lint rules in README.md; fix the 'eight rules' miscount
why: learning_tracker_lints.dart's doc comment claims 'eight rules' but lists and registers nine (NoColorLiteralOutsideTheme, NoCurriculumDisplayNameBypass, NoEToStringInUi, NoFeatureCrossImport, NoFirebaseOutsideCore, NoHardcodedDomainTerm, NoHardcodedTextDirection, NoRawLogEvent, NoRawTalker). README.md documents only 5 (Rules 1-5: curriculum-bypass, feature-cross-import, firebase-outside-core, raw-talker, hardcoded-text-direction) and its 'Configuration' disable-list matches only those 5. Verified via git log that no_color_literal_outside_theme (0c66c611), no_hardcoded_domain_term (e84e880f), and no_e_to_string_in_ui + no_raw_logevent (bc327fef) were each added in commits that never touched README.md — the doc was last updated in a56ac75b, before any of those three commits. A developer hitting one of the 4 undocumented rules gets no 'why it exists'/'how to fix' guidance the other 5 rules provide.
recommendation: Add README.md sections for no_color_literal_outside_theme, no_hardcoded_domain_term, no_e_to_string_in_ui, and no_raw_logevent (same What/Why/How-to-fix format as Rules 1-5), extend the Configuration disable-list to all 9, and fix the doc-comment count.
acceptance_criteria: packages/custom_lints/README.md documents all 9 rules registered in learning_tracker_lints.dart.
learning_tracker_lints.dart's doc comment count matches the actual list length.
